entry.title: tingao/debian-on-s23-ultra
entry.summary: A Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra running Debian 13 as a server. The bootloader is locked, so an app re-establishes root after every reboot: Shizuku, CVE-2026-43499, KernelSU Next late-load, then a Debian chroot with sshd. One APK, quickstart, chroot bootstrap, and notes on everything that did not work.
